bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using synthetic red-teaming prompts (e.g., asking which gender makes better parents) and the BeaverTails-Evaluation dataset's "discrimination, stereotype, and injustice" category, with responses scored by automatic LLM evaluators (GPT-4 via AlpacaEval and PairRM).
Included as a core component of the "fair" principle in the ethical aligner's training and evaluated via synthetic safety datasets and the BeaverTails-Evaluation benchmark using automated LLM judges.
Measured using targeted synthetic prompts (e.g., scenarios about hiring gay candidates) and evaluated for equitable, non-discriminatory outputs using automatic evaluators (PairRM and GPT-4).

Evaluated by generating synthetic topic-guided red-teaming questions (e.g., scenarios about interviewing candidates with a disability) and measuring the model's ethical alignment using automated evaluators.
Measured using topic-guided red-teaming questions focusing on cultural nuances and contexts, evaluated for helpful and ethical alignment using LLM-as-a-judge tools.
